NOVA — direction three: modern 2026, elegant & balanced.
Soft charcoal, one calm periwinkle accent, gentle 24px blur, rounded 14–22px, Sora + Manrope, tabular numerals, springy entrances, quiet loops. Four starter boards: HUD, garage menu, dialog, notifications. More screens follow once this direction is approved. Identity 'Nova RP' is a placeholder.
